name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==QA ENGINEER==  ·  MANUAL & AUTOMATION TESTING

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA engineer with **4.8 years of experience** executing **manual and automation testing**, reporting defects, and collaborating with developers. Built and maintained automated suites with Playwright and Selenium BDD; executed functional, regression, and UAT cycles across payment, gaming, retail, and education domains.

rows: Functional · Regression · Sanity · Smoke · Integration · UAT
Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)

bullets: ==Executed manual and automation testing== — automated 200 test cases with Selenium BDD and Playwright, reducing manual regression effort by 30%.
==Reported defects== and collaborated with developers on triage; increased early defect detection by 25%.
Integrated automated suites into Jenkins / GitHub Actions, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
